semantics.animation_gate: AnimationVM_TickActors services the table only when (0x00FF7E28 & 1) != 0.
semantics.eligibility: A live actor must have a nonzero animation pointer at record +0x20; otherwise the VM does not consume a stream. A nonzero delay at +0x37 decrements instead of servicing the stream.
semantics.initializer: Actor_InitializeFromTemplate clears runtime frame, movement, animation timer, and linked-resource fields after copying the compact template.
semantics.f5: AnimationVM_SpawnOrCopyActor applies source-relative signed offsets and can override animation/movement cursors from the F5 payload.

conclusion: The first interaction-refill actor is a separate scheduler boundary from the opening player F5 actor. It is allocated at 0x001B5270 during MAME frame 0x536, while the low-bit animation gate crosses to 0x91 at 0x001A8C1E; the actor is then observed briefly at the next stable state with cursor 0x00122C12 and no frame pointer before returning to zero. This confirms a real allocation/eligibility boundary but does not establish that all mode-0 or mode-3 animation spawns share the same immediate-service rule.
next_action: Decode the 0x00122C12 stream and trace the first command that returns slot 8 to a zero cursor; use that as the next native actor-refill regression fixture.
